title: Austin's Bond Election Certified
summary:
*   Austin City officials held a special meeting to officially certify the results of a city bond election.
*   The council formally declared the outcome of the public vote, which had taken place two days prior on September 9th.
*   All council members present voted unanimously to adopt the resolution, making the bond election results official.
